model_annotation: The chart displays the relationship between age and an unspecified variable, represented by four distinct lines. The x-axis, labeled "Alter" (German for "age"), spans from 20 to 70 in increments of 10, with a linear scale. The y-axis lacks a label but features a linear scale with four unlabeled tick marks. The four lines, colored dark blue, light blue, gray, and black, are plotted against the age range. The dark blue line starts at a low value around 20, fluctuates between 0 and a moderate value until age 60, and then drops sharply to 0 by age 69. The light blue, gray, and black lines exhibit similar trends, with the light blue line starting at 0 around age 20, peaking around age 28, and then gradually decreasing to 0 by age 69. The gray and black lines follow a similar pattern, with the black line remaining consistently above the other three lines until age 60, after which all four lines converge and decline to 0.
